newsitem.title: USA: US CFTC says CBOT has adequate market surveillance.
newsitem.headline: US CFTC says CBOT has adequate market surveillance.

text.p: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission said on Tuesday that the Chicago Board of Trade takes too long to compelete investigations.

"The Division found that the CBOT maintains an adequate market surveilance program for monitoring contract expirations, but that several market surveillance investigations took an unduly long time to complete," the CFTC's Division of Trading and Markets said.
In a statement, the division recommended that the CBOT take appropriate steps to improve significantly the timeliness of such investigations.
The CFTC carried out the routine review of the CBOT's self-regulatory programs from April, 1994, to September, 1996, under the Commodity Exchange Act.
